An **environment** is one job on the scanner with its own scoring rule. A **level** sets the hidden-world prior and the budget. An **episode** is one seeded attempt. **Kind** is the claim of the registry: `sandbox` (no reward), `candidate` (scored; its gate is not stored on this engine yet), `admitted` (the stored gate admits every level of the claim) or `practice` (scored; not part of a claim). The gate gives one verdict per level, never one per instance; it is described in [docs/DESIGN.md](../docs/DESIGN.md), `mrgym gate <id> --n 300 --write` measures and stores it, and `mrgym check <id>` compares the kind with what is stored.
